words.gram: used on its own to close a matter

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
Present есть; у меня есть = I have.

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

examples.text: Приводи её сегодня к Димону на вечеринку!
examples.trans: Bring her to Dimon's party tonight!

examples.text: Подожди, что это за страшная вонь?
examples.trans: Wait, what is this terrible stench?
She will raise a stink on the internet.

meanings.en: after all, still, all the same

examples.text: Аркаш, мне москвичи звонят каждый день. Может, всё-таки передумаем?
examples.trans: Arkasha, the people from Moscow call me every day. Maybe we should reconsider after all?

examples.text: А ты иди домой и делай уроки.
examples.trans: And you go home and do your homework.

examples.text: Так, мы идём к слепым. А ты иди домой и делай уроки.
examples.trans: Right, we're going to the blind people. And you go home and do your homework.

examples.text: Позвони мне вечером. Договоримся на завтра.
examples.trans: Call me this evening. We'll arrange something for tomorrow.

meanings.en: prep work, prepped ingredients (in a kitchen)

examples.text: Заготовка на завтра сама себя сделает?
Заготовка на завтра сама себя не сделает!
examples.trans: Tomorrow's prep will not do itself!

examples.text: Утром все повара начинают день с чистки и нарезки заготовок.
examples.trans: In the morning all the cooks start the day by cleaning and slicing prep ingredients.
I declare the court session closed.

examples.text: Хорошая идея! Я сейчас же попробую.
examples.trans: Good idea! I will try right now.

meanings.note: To run for a second term.

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: В интернете = on the internet. International borrowing from English 'Internet' ('inter-' + 'network').

examples.trans: Look it up on the internet.
Look it up on the internet.
There's someone here to see you.

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, извините, тут к вам человек.
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, I'm sorry, there's a man here to see you.
Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?

meanings.note: в кухне / на кухне = in the kitchen, на кухню = to the kitchen
E.g. русская кухня. Entered Russian via Polish 'kuchnia' and Middle High German 'küchen', ultimately from Late Latin 'coquina' (from 'coquere', to cook).

examples.trans: And the kitchen is over there.
We are sitting in the kitchen.

examples.text: Проходите, пожалуйста! Как видите, большой коридор, а там кухня.
examples.trans: Come on in, please! As you can see, a big hall, and the kitchen is over there.
Can I go and have a look?

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
short form 'нужен / нужна / нужно / нужны' + dative: 'мне нужна работа' = I need a job
accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.text: Она нашла нас на новом месте.
examples.trans: She found us at the new place.
That is it, she got really offended.
She is not answering her phone.

поднять.gloss: to lift, to raise; to rouse

examples.text: А я глаза на это закрывать не буду. Я подниму людей!
examples.trans: Well, I'm not going to close my eyes to this. I'll rally people!

meanings.note: person visiting a person, place, or institution

examples.trans: A visitor was sitting in the reception room.

examples.text: Это журнал посетителей мэрии из полицейских вещдоков.
examples.trans: This is the mayor's visitor log from police evidence.

examples.text: Зато в ресторане станет больше посетителей.
examples.trans: On the other hand, there will be more patrons in the restaurant.
Why are we going so slowly?

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!
How much are you selling them for?

examples.text: Конечно надо! Почём ты их продаёшь?
examples.trans: Of course I do! How much are you selling them for?
So you really are selling it?

meanings.en: to happen, take place, go on
meanings.note: Что происходит? = What is going on?

examples.trans: What is going on? I don't understand.

examples.text: Мы не знаем, что с нашей дочерью происходит!
examples.trans: We don't know what is happening with our daughter!

пускать.gloss: to let in, to allow to go

meanings.en: to let in, to allow to pass
meanings.note: Не пускайте его = don't let him in.

examples.trans: The guard doesn't let anyone inside.

examples.text: Не пускайте его, пожалуйста! Это мой бывший парень.
examples.trans: Don't let him in, please! That's my ex-boyfriend.

пустить.gloss: to let go; to let in

examples.trans: Why did you even come here? Empty-handed!

meanings.en: to try, to attempt, to make an effort

examples.trans: He tried to explain the situation.

examples.text: Пыталась? С бутылкой вина в руке?
examples.trans: You tried? With a bottle of wine in your hand?

meanings.note: Dining establishment. Borrowed from French 'restaurant' (from 'restaurer', to restore strength with rich broth); entered Russian in the early 19th century.

examples.trans: They called from the Italian restaurant.
In the evening they went to a restaurant.

examples.text: Кстати, звонили из итальянского ресторана. Дарят папе романтический ужин на двоих.
examples.trans: By the way, they called from the Italian restaurant. They're giving Dad a romantic dinner for two.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

examples.text: Я и сама хорошо проведу время.
examples.trans: I'll have a good time on my own.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо сделать ещё больше.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.

examples.text: А с Пашей я снова чувствую себя женщиной.
examples.trans: And with Pasha I feel like a woman again.
The wind is blowing hard outside.

examples.text: Я так два года потеряла. Любила так сильно!
examples.trans: I lost two years like that. I loved him so much!

meanings.note: At the start of a question.

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?
So I shouldn't wait for you tonight?

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

examples.trans: The cup fell off the table.

examples.text: А потом на меня упал мусор с ветки.
examples.trans: And then rubbish fell on me from a branch.

examples.text: Ого, двадцать тысяч рублей? Ничего себе цена!
examples.trans: Wow, twenty thousand rubles? What a price!

examples.text: Тогда цена выросла до семисот евро!
examples.trans: Then the price has risen to seven hundred euros!

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

meanings.note: Informal. Borrowed from French 'chef' (head, leader, from Latin 'caput'); in Russian kitchen culture 'шеф' is the standard form of address for the executive head chef.

examples.trans: The chef is in the kitchen.
